news.hook: A wild hit on Jared Goff sent the ball backward, but officials ruled it an incomplete pass instead of a Saints touchdown. The call flipped the game and fueled endless debate.
news.name: Lions Edge Saints 31-30 in OT After Controversial Replay Call
news.summary: In Week 1 at Ford Field, the Detroit Lions held off a stunning Saints comeback to win 31-30 in overtime, sparked by a second-quarter replay reversal that negated what looked like a New Orleans defensive score. Chase Young's strip sack on Goff appeared to be a fumble returned for a touchdown, but refs called it a forward pass based on Goff's throwing motion and arm position. Tyler Shough threw for 410 yards and three scores to rally the Saints from 21 down, but they failed a two-point try in OT. Lions stars Jahmyr Gibbs and Amon-Ra St. Brown scored key touchdowns, while Derrick Barnes added a fun touch arriving in matching Spider-Man suits with his son.
